# Third-party libraries

These files are unmodified browser builds copied from npm by `npm run vendor`, so the site needs no build step.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion.min.js` | [Motion](https://motion.dev) (`motion/dist/motion.js`) | 14.14.0 | MIT — see [LICENSE-motion.md](LICENSE-motion.md) |
| `anime.min.js` | [Anime.js](https://animejs.com) (`animejs/dist/bundles/anime.umd.min.js`) | 4.5.0 | MIT — see [LICENSE-animejs.md](LICENSE-animejs.md) |

They are third-party code and keep their own copyright and licence; the project's own MIT licence (`/LICENSE`) covers the rest of the repository.
